changes: Loads NewzDeck-owned sab_engine.py and automation_engine.py directly from their current source bytes instead of accepting timestamp-based adjacent .pyc files.
Purges the application-level __pycache__ on backend startup and disables adjacent bytecode writes for the NewzDeck source runtime.
Deletes stale application __pycache__ during installed upgrades before the new backend is started.
Adds release guards for source-byte module loading and installed-upgrade cleanup so deterministic packaging cannot revive a stale adapter again.
Preserves v3.6.9 in-app update runtime handoff and all accepted v3.6.8 image-browsing performance improvements.
